modalities.evidence: MRI data from T1 and FLAIR weighted images

output.population: 85 people with epilepsy due to focal cortical dysplasia type II and 85 healthy controls
output.summary: Presurgery T1 and FLAIR MRI from people with epilepsy due to focal cortical dysplasia type II and healthy controls, with manually labeled lesion masks and selected clinical features, intended for automated lesion detection.
